chunks: He said: Ali (peace be upon him) said: The Messenger of Allah visited his daughter Fatima (peace be upon her), and on her neck was a necklace. He turned away from her. She cut it and threw it aside. The Messenger of Allah said to her: You are from me, O Fatima. Then a beggar came, and she gave him the necklace. The Messenger of Allah said: Allah's anger and my anger is intensified against whoever sheds my blood and harms me regarding my progeny.

key_terms.عِتْرَتِي: Itrati -- my progeny/family, referring to the Ahl al-Bayt; harming them is equated with harming the Prophet himself
key_terms.غَضَب: Ghadab -- anger/wrath, here both divine and prophetic anger combined as a warning
key_terms.قِلَادَة: Qiladah -- necklace, symbolizing worldly adornment that Fatima renounced

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about harming his family and progeny?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) narrates an incident where the Prophet visited his daughter Fatima (SA) and found her wearing a necklace. He turned away, signaling his displeasure at adornment. Fatima immediately cut the necklace off and gave it to a beggar who arrived. Pleased, the Prophet affirmed her closeness to him and then issued a stern warning: both Allah's anger and his own are intensified against anyone who sheds his blood or harms his family (itra). This hadith highlights Fatima's selflessness and the Prophet's fierce protectiveness over his progeny.

en.bilal-muhammad: He said: `Ali (as) said: The Messenger of Allah (s) visited his daughter Fatima (sa), and on her neck was a necklace. So, he turned away from her. So, she cut it and threw it aside. Then, the Messenger of Allah (s) said to her: You are from me, Fatima. Then, a beggar came, so she gave him the necklace. Then, the Messenger of Allah (s) said: Allah’s anger and my anger is intensified against he who sheds my blood and harms me in my progeny.
